business_problem: Digital Turbine needed a better way to support adtech data lake modernization and mobile advertising analytics because multiple ETL-based warehouses were expensive to maintain and still could not deliver data fast enough in the formats needed by data science and BI teams.
solution_summary: Digital Turbine uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support adtech data lake modernization and mobile advertising analytics. The implementation replaced a legacy state where multiple ETL-based warehouses were expensive to maintain and still could not deliver data fast enough in the formats needed by data science and BI teams. Mobile device and ad data and etl warehouse feeds move through Lakeflow Jobs and Structured Streaming and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL operationalizes models, agents, and analytics that deliver advertiser and publisher analytics and data science datasets.
business_outcome: Digital Turbine improved adtech data lake modernization and mobile advertising analytics with measurable results including 10s of $1,000s, 10–20% monthly savings on hosting and other costs, and 20% less time spent debugging issues between data systems, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
metrics: 10–20% monthly savings on hosting and other costs
